title: Caramelized Fennel Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful soup perfect for a chilly evening. The caramelized fennel adds a sweet and anise-like flavor that's sure to please.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the sliced fennel and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally, about 20-25 minutes.
Pour in the broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer until the fennel is tender, about 15-20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Stir in the Greek yogurt and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
